name: Launch A — Reminder: 1 Hour Before

supporting: Soap Opera Email #5 (urgency + CTA) applied to attendance.
Funnel Hacker's Cookbook — the 1-hour touch is the last reliable calendar interrupt.

purpose: One job: make the next hour about the event. Short, specific, one link. SMS leads; email is the fallback for anyone without SMS consent or a phone on the profile.

trigger.late_registrant_rule: Registered inside the final hour: send immediately with honest copy ("starting soon"), once only.

sms.body_framework: Name + "starting in 1 hour" + time + join URL. One line, no pitch.

email.send: 1 hour before, to everyone; primary channel for no-SMS contacts
email.body_framework: One line: starts in one hour, time in their zone. One line: the single thing they will learn. Join button. Nothing else.

copy_rules: Under 60 words for the email body; one line for SMS.
Time in the registrant's own zone.
No price, no countdown, no offer language.
No second CTA. The join link is the only action.
guards: SMS DND or no consent -> email only.
Do not send both channels to the same contact unless SMS is the consented channel; email is the fallback, not a duplicate.

ghl_build.structure: Trigger: Tag Added `webinar-registered` -> Wait until `webinar_datetime` - 1h -> If not purchased and future -> If SMS consent -> Send SMS -> Else -> Send Email -> End.
ghl_build.notes: SMS-first. The email exists so no-SMS registrants are not left out; do not send both to the same contact by default.

scope.includes: Registered, not purchased, one hour out.
